summary.text: Tony Niemiec is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and previously represented the district from 2023 to 2025.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, in which he defeated incumbent Marlene Brady.

paragraphs.text: Tony Niemiec was born in Steubenville, Ohio, and graduated from Green River High School in 1987.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps and reached the rank of Sergeant.
His career experience includes working as a patrol corporal in the Sweetwater County sheriff's office and owning the Tomahawk Tavern.
Niemiec assumed office in the Wyoming House on January 2, 2023, succeeding Mark Baker, and left office on January 6, 2025.

His 2023-2024 committee assignments were the Joint Judiciary Committee, the Joint Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee, the Air Transportation Liaison Committee and the Military and Veterans Affairs Task Force.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2024 race for District 60 that he lost in the primary.
